planner.summary: Add ** (exponentiation) and make sure every result is a finite real number.
steps: Catch OverflowError and ZeroDivisionError and raise ValueError instead.
Reject complex or infinite results with ValueError.
Add ** to the accepted operators and menu text.
edge_cases: Negative base with a fractional exponent gives a complex number

programmer_summary: Added a ** branch that converts overflow and zero-division errors to ValueError and rejects complex or infinite results.

reviewer.summary: Overflow, zero to a negative power, and complex results are all turned into ValueError, so the console keeps running.
limitations: Review is based on reading the code; no tests were run.
